title: Milne’s rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ abelian variety A/Q̄ with good reduction A_0 at w, ∀ rational Hodge class γ ∈ H^{2r}, ∀ divisors D_1..D_{d-r} on A_0: the pairings Tr(γ_0·c_1(D_1)⋯c_1(D_{d-r})) in all ℓ-adic (ℓ≠p) and crystalline realizations equal one common rational number q
backbone: Transport each specialized Hodge class through Hodge-type integral models to a pullback from a CM abelian variety, then reduce CM classes to balanced Weil classes with rational divisor pairings.

title: The full BSD formula from low Selmer corank
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ E/Q, ∀ prime q: s_q(E)∈{0,1} → r(E)=ord_{s=1}L(E,s)=s_q(E) ∧ #Ш(E/Q)<∞ ∧ L^{(r)}(E,1)/r! = Ω_E Reg_E #Ш ∏c_ℓ / #E(Q)_tors²
backbone: Combine the low-corank Selmer converse with prime-by-prime integral determinant comparisons (Selmer complexes, Heegner/theta families, character-division tests) to match each p-part of the BSD leading term.

title: The quasi-Riemann hypothesis
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ q ≥1, ∀ Dirichlet character χ mod q, ∀ s ∈ ℂ with Re s > 7/8 and ¬(χ principal ∧ s=1): L(s,χ) ≠ 0 (in particular ζ(s)≠0 for Re s>7/8)
backbone: Assume zeros right of 7/8; a character sum bounded directly (sextic large sieve, recursive moments) and via a Mellin integral of 1/L continues 1/L past the rightmost zero, contradiction.

title: Hilbert’s tenth problem over ℚ
subject: Number theory
claim: ¬∃ algorithm A such that ∀ n, ∀ f ∈ Z[X_1..X_n]: A(f) decides whether ∃ x ∈ Q^n with f(x)=0
backbone: Integer solvability reduces to an effective family of finite rational-solvability tests; compactness plus elliptic and abelian-surface height bounds show all tests succeeding forces an integer zero.

title: Irrationality of Catalan’s constant
subject: Number theory
backbone: Assume G rational; explicit determinants Delta_N of moment matrices are then rational and nonzero, but p-adic denominator bounds and real-place size estimates force |Delta_N|<1, a contradiction.

title: Goldfeld’s conjecture: densities and mean analytic rank
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ elliptic curve E/ℚ, ∀ j∈{0,1}: lim_{X→∞} #{d∈D(X): ord_{s=1}L(E^{(d)},s)=j}/#D(X) = 1/2 (signed squarefree d ordered by |d|); with companion: mean analytic rank → 1/2
backbone: Selmer-corank densities plus a 2-converse: binary families of quadratic twists with bounded 2-adic determinant coordinates give nonvanishing at nonzero vertices, and integral interpolation recovers it at the missing vertex.

title: Ordinary two-point correlations and the corrected Elliott conjecture
subject: Number theory
backbone: Dilation comparison yields a weighted divisor graph; centered prime supplies, independent-residue comparison and a high-trace closed-walk count bound its operator, giving exponential decay in J ~ loglog X.

title: The Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture
subject: Number theory
claim: ∃ homogeneous σ_{2k+1} ∈ W_{2k+1} (k≥1) such that Lie_Q⟨e_3,e_5,…⟩ → (grt=W,{,}), e_{2k+1}↦σ_{2k+1}, is an isomorphism of graded Lie algebras (and on weight completions)
backbone: A characteristic-two degeneration of the pentagon bounds each weight's dimension; holonomy constructs odd-weight elements with nonzero x^{n-1}y coefficient; induction on weight squeezes the dimension to freeness.

title: Function-field reconstruction from Milnor K-theory and Galois data
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ prime ℓ, ∀ f.g. K/k, L/l over alg. closed k,l with char ≠ ℓ and trdeg ≥ 2: the canonical map Isom^i_F(K,L) → Isom_M(K^M_1/ℓ(K), K^M_1/ℓ(L))/F_ℓ^× is a bijection
backbone: From K1/l, K2/l and their product, successively recover quasi-divisorial valuations, residual-curve points, curve and rational subfields, then the field itself, unique up to scalar and Frobenius.

title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ finite E/Q_2, ∀ continuous odd absolutely irreducible r: G_Q → GL_2(E) unramified outside finitely many primes: ∃ odd N, ∃ continuous λ: T_2(N) → O_E with λ(T_ℓ)=tr r(Frob_ℓ), λ(ℓS_ℓ)=det r(Frob_ℓ) for ℓ∤2N
backbone: Place r in a trace family with potential automorphic support over a solvable totally real field, find a regular classical point, and propagate Hecke support along the component to r.

title: Prime-factor statistics of $`p-1`$
subject: Number theory
claim: For p uniform among primes ≤ x: ∀ k, ∀ bounded continuous F on [0,1]^k: E[F(V_1(p),…,V_k(p))] → E[F(L_1,…,L_k)] as x→∞, where V_j=log q_j(p)/log(p-1) and (L_j) ~ PD(1)
backbone: Compute interior joint factor statistics of p-1 via a marked Type II estimate and signed graph-moment bounds, then pass to ranked factors and PD(1) by size-biased sampling.

title: Independent largest prime factors of consecutive integers
subject: Number theory
backbone: Reduce to mixed decorrelation of bin characters; a nonzero mixed correlation yields a profinite limit profile whose divisor-weight amplification gives positive energy contradicting MRT cancellation.

title: Ostmann’s inverse Goldbach conjecture
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ A,B ⊆ Z_{≥0} with |A|,|B| ≥ 2: (A+B) △ P is infinite
backbone: Assume a finite modification of the primes equals A+B; residue restrictions, amplified moments with Poisson summation, and the quadratic large sieve force quadratic structure contradicting a collision estimate.

title: Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ k=F̄_q (or alg. closed char p with p very good, p∤|W_G|), ∀ smooth projective connected curve X/k, ∀ connected reductive G satisfying the four characteristic hypotheses: L_G^restr: Shv_Nilp(Bun_G(X)) ≃ IndCoh_Nilp(LocSys^restr) is an equivalence
backbone: Assume a spectral component is missed; lifting to characteristic zero gives a nonzero sheaf with vanishing nearby cycles, which Hecke transversality and slicing show impossible.

title: Torus-packet equidistribution in prime, quartic, and sextic degrees
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ prime n ≥ 5, ∀ sequences (K_i,M_i,σ_i) of totally real degree-n fields with full lattices and D(M_i) → ∞: μ_{K_i,M_i,σ_i} → m_n weakly (Haar, no escape of mass)
backbone: Unfold packet measures into weighted ideal counts; Stark and Shiu bounds give nonescape and small-ball bounds, hence positive entropy, so measure rigidity identifies every weak limit as Haar.

title: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ number field K ∀ abelian variety A/K ∀ irreducible X⊆A_K̄: #{maximal atypical subvarieties of X in ⟨X⟩_sp} < ∞
backbone: Reduce finiteness to a non-density sequence theorem; a minimal counterexample is split into height scales, and height inequalities, arithmetic positivity and a product cut with descent contradict minimality.

title: The irrationality exponent of π is 2
subject: Number theory
claim: μ(π) = 2, i.e. ∀ ν>2 ∃ Q(ν) ∀ p,q ∈ Z with q ≥ Q(ν): |π − p/q| ≥ q^{−ν}
backbone: Suppose infinitely many too-good approximations to pi; a separated-weight interpolation theorem builds a nonzero determinant whose arithmetic lower bound and analytic upper bound are incompatible.

title: The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global fields
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ global field k, ∀ absolutely almost simple simply connected G/k, ∀ N ◁ G(k) with N ⊄ Z(G(k)): ∃ open normal W ◁ H_A=∏_{v∈A(G)} G(k_v) with N = δ_A^{-1}(W)
backbone: Reduce to anisotropic special unitary groups and the finite power-defect quotient V; prove V trivial by induction on the degree, excluding finite characters and simple quotients via approximation and recurrence.

title: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ prime p, ∀ finite k/Q_p, ∀ smooth proper geometrically connected curve X/k of genus ≥2: X(k) → {sections of π_1(X) → G_k}/π_1(X_k̄)-conjugacy is bijective
backbone: Pop-Stix localize sections at valuations; constructing finite etale covers with roots on disk collars (stable skeleta, cyclic covers) shows the universal etale tower is dense, forcing a rational point.

title: Squarefree quartics and power-free polynomial values
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ irreducible f ∈ Z[x] of degree 4 with no fixed prime-square divisor: #{1≤n≤X : f(n) squarefree} = c_f X + o(X), c_f = ∏_p (1 − ρ_f(p²)/p²) > 0
backbone: Sieve reduces the density to a large-prime tail estimate, which is proved by number-field factorization and determinant-method counting with adaptive auxiliary primes plus explicit low-degree surface and curve geometry.

title: A quadratic bound for Jacobsthal’s function
subject: Number theory
claim: ∃ C>0 ∀ k≥1: h(k) ≤ C k²/(log log 3k)², where h(k) = max over n with ω(n)≤k of the Jacobsthal function j(n)
backbone: Lower-bound sieve survivors through a decreasing-prime Buchstab tree compared with a renewal-process reference tree at the limiting sieve parameter; an inverse estimate, variance bounds and stopping rules control the discrepancy.

title: The weak inhomogeneous Duffin–Schaeffer conjecture
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ γ ∈ R, ∀ ψ: N → [0,∞): Σ_q φ(q)ψ(q)/q = ∞ → for a.e. x ∈ R, ‖qx − γ‖ < ψ(q) for infinitely many q
backbone: Reduce to small fixed-mass blocks and a second-moment (overlap) bound proved by weighted lcm estimates and simultaneous-birth comparisons, then transfer positive measure to full measure.

title: Patterson's first moment for cubic Gauss sums
subject: Number theory
backbone: Exact decomposition of the prime sum into Type I sums (via cubic Voronoi) and bilinear sums (corrected dispersion with the cubic large sieve) yields the sharp-cutoff main term.

title: An asymptotic formula for the number of totients
subject: Number theory
claim: V(x) ~ (x/log x) G_m A(1;θ) with 0 < inf A ≤ sup A < ∞, and ∀ c>0: V(cx)/V(x) → c
backbone: Outside an exceptional set every totient preimage has a long prime prefix; prefix volumes plus collision bounds from a layered shifted-prime sieve give an asymptotic for distinct values.

title: Short Egyptian fractions
subject: Number theory
claim: ∃ c_1,c_2>0 ∀^∞ b: c_1 log log b ≤ N(b) ≤ c_2 log log b, N(b) = max_{1≤a<b} (least number of distinct unit fractions summing to a/b)
backbone: Greedy steps reduce to A/C; descending through O(log S) numerator ranges with divisors of an auxiliary M having small residues yields a dense representable family covering A/C.

title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
subject: Number theory
backbone: Construct a nonnegative sieve weight making a prime in (m,m+h] likely and (m+h,m+2h] nearly empty; second-moment estimates turn weighted mass into a positive proportion of long gaps with bounded multiplicity.

title: Potential integral density on curve character varieties
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ smooth connected complex curve X, ∀ r ≥1, ∀ quasi-unipotent classes C_1..C_s: ∃ number field L (finite over K) such that M_r(X)(O_L) ∩ Y(C) is Zariski dense in every component of Y
backbone: Induct on rank of surface diagrams: cut maximal-rank facets to disks, split into subspace and quotient, glue integral solutions, treat closed surfaces separately, then select boundary classes.

title: Uniformly bounded components of Gaussian-prime graphs
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ D < ∞: ¬∃ infinite sequence of distinct Gaussian primes with successive distances ≤ D (more strongly ∀D ∃B_D: every component of G_D has ≤ B_D vertices)
backbone: Reduce to a finite periodic sieve obstruction; a walk assumed to avoid randomly chosen zero classes gains entropy and coverage, incurring information cost beyond the entropy budget.

title: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ a ∈ Z with a ≠ −1 and a not a square: ∃^∞ primes p with ord_p(a) = p−1 (quantitatively ≥ c_a x/(log x)² such p in (x,2x) for x ≥ x_a)
backbone: Hooley's index-divisor reduction: sieve many primes with controlled predecessors p-1=crQ and control Kummer splitting by a uniform Chebotarev bound from a new Hecke zero-free region.

title: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ imaginary quadratic K, ∀ elliptic curve E/K: ∃ isobaric automorphic π_E of GL_2(A_K) with r_ι(π_E) ≃ H^1_et(E_K̄, Q̄_l) for all l, ι, and matching local parameters at every place
backbone: Build cyclic covers of twists whose Jacobian character pieces give rank-two systems; specialize to a fiber with good residual and local properties, apply automorphy lifting, switch primes, descend.

title: Uchida’s conjecture for open homomorphisms of Galois groups
subject: Number theory
claim: ∀ number fields F_1,F_2, ∀ solvably closed Galois E_i/F_i, ∀ continuous open α: Gal(E_1/F_1) → Gal(E_2/F_2): ∃! field embedding j: E_2 ↪ E_1 inducing α
backbone: From Uchida's partial local correspondences, Frobenius detection of l-adic characters and matching residue characteristics show the cyclotomic character is preserved; Hoshi's criterion gives the embedding.

title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ complex CM abelian variety A, ∀ p ≥ 0, ∀ α ∈ H^{2p}(A,ℚ)∩H^{p,p}(A): ∃ Z ∈ CH^p(A)_ℚ with cl_B(Z) = α
backbone: Reduce Hodge monomials on CM abelian varieties to balanced tensors on auxiliary CM factors, connect type lists by algebraic four-factor switches (via theta one-forms on ball quotients), assemble and descend.

title: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ compact Fujiki-class-C manifold X, ∀ rational SNC boundary Δ, ∀ connected-fibre surjection f:X→Y onto a normal compact complex space: κ(X,K_X+Δ) ≥ κ(F,K_F+Δ_F) + κ(f|Δ)
backbone: Relative Iitaka reduction gives an exact comparison of pluricanonical sections with an adjoint pair (W,T,M) carrying a Hodge line; adjoint positivity of that line plus log-general-type addition yields the inequality.

title: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: Assuming log Iitaka subadditivity: ∀ normal irreducible compact Kähler space X, ∀ effective ℚ-divisor Δ with (X,Δ) lc and K_X+Δ ℚ-Cartier: K_X+Δ analytically nef → K_X+Δ semiample
backbone: Prove by dimension induction a stronger birational statement (semiample positive part plus effective negative part) using analytic MMP programs, boundary generation along dlt strata and descent along fibrations.

title: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ alg. closed k with char p > 3, ∀ projective lc threefold pair (X,B) over k with B effective ℚ-divisor and K_X+B ℚ-Cartier: (K_X+B nef ∧ ν(K_X+B)=1) → K_X+B semiample
backbone: Assuming failure (nef dimension three), reduce to a terminal model and build a prepared boundary cycle whose existence is forbidden by the companion cycle-obstruction theorem.

title: Numerical semiampleness and generalized minimal models
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ projective klt ℚ-pair (X,B) over an alg. closed char-0 field, ∀ nef ℚ-Cartier M: (K_X+B pseudo-effective ∧ K_X+B+M nef) → ∃ semiample ℚ-Cartier L with K_X+B+M ≡ L
backbone: Simultaneous dimension induction: reduce full nef dimension to klt Calabi-Yau pairs, force bigness of M via jets and Frobenius comparison, then descend positive parts along the nef reduction.

title: The ordinary-double-point volume gap
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ n ≥ 2, ∀ singular klt germ (X,x) of dimension n with zero boundary: nvol(x,X) ≤ 2(n−1)^n, and equality ⇔ (X,x)_an ≅ ordinary double point
backbone: Induction on dimension from known low-dimensional and fourfold cases: stable degeneration to a K-polystable cone, stabilizer and jet-cone estimates force smooth Gorenstein cone, then quadric characterization.

title: Fujita’s freeness conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ n ≥ 1, ∀ smooth connected complex projective X of dimension n, ∀ ample line bundle L: K_X+(n+1)L is globally generated
backbone: If generation fails, an attained exponential minimization yields a center; positive-dimensional centers die by first-variation versus Brunn-Minkowski contradiction; isolated centers lift sections by vanishing.

title: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ r ≥ 10, for very general (p_1,…,p_r) ∈ (P^2_ℂ)^r, ∀ nonzero effective plane curve C of degree d, ∀ m_i ≤ mult_{p_i}C: Σ m_i < d√r
backbone: Assume a violating curve; specialize points onto a chosen plane curve to get a normal polynomial, collide points, and show the limiting interpolation matrix has full rank.

title: Bloch’s conjecture for complex surfaces
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ smooth connected projective complex surface S with p_g(S)=0: alb_S: CH_0(S)^0 → Alb(S)(ℂ) is an isomorphism (integral coefficients)
backbone: Equivariant obstruction theory on determinant-fixed Quot schemes; virtual localization gives a Chow relation whose diagonal coefficient is nonzero (lattice-rank and K^2=9 cases), forcing CH_0 = Z.

title: Hyperkähler SYZ and projective-space bases
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ compact IHS Kähler manifold X, ∀ holomorphic line bundle L with c_1(L) ≠ 0 nef and q_X(c_1(L)) = 0: L is semiample
backbone: Build a monodromy-tracked degeneration, construct a special Lagrangian torus from collapsing Ricci-flat metrics, hyperkahler-rotate to a holomorphic Lagrangian torus making e semiample, then deform back via Soldatenkov-Verbitsky.

title: Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ complex K3 surface X: X is Oka, i.e. ∀ m, ∀ compact convex K ⊂ ℂ^m, ∀ f holomorphic near K, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ entire F: ℂ^m → X with sup_K d(F,f) < ε
backbone: A local criterion (two complete holomorphic directions) feeds spray-gluing to polydisc and convex approximation; complete directions on every K3 are built via symplectic sewing, degenerations and period dynamics.

title: P = W for fixed-determinant SLn moduli spaces
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ smooth projective complex curve C of genus ≥ 2, ∀ composite n ≥ 4, ∀ d with gcd(n,d)=1, ∀ L ∈ Pic^d(C), ∀ m,k: P_k H^m(X^B,ℚ) = W_{2k} H^m(X^B,ℚ) = W_{2k+1} H^m(X^B,ℚ)
backbone: Construct a common lowering operator f with [[f,e],e]=-2e on full fixed-determinant cohomology, verify Lefschetz properties for both perverse and weight filtrations, and apply a linear-algebra two-filtration comparison criterion.

title: The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ finite quiver Q, ∀ dimension and framing vectors, ∀ commuting flavor torus F, ∀ regular stability character ν: H_F^*(X;ℂ) ≅ ℂ[Y_f^ν] as graded R-algebras (both coefficient maps surjective with equal kernels)
backbone: Abelianize the Coulomb algebra with minuscule generators, test relations by stable pairs for a surjection, bound Betti numbers by a multipartition filtration, identify the cocharacter-fixed scheme.

title: Shafarevich counterexamples in dimension two and with large fundamental group
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∃ smooth connected projective complex fourfold X (with simple abelian surface A ⊂ X, im(π_1(A)→π_1(X)) ≅ ℤ) such that X has large π_1, X̃ contains no positive-dimensional compact analytic subvariety, and X̃ is not Stein
backbone: Build a fourfold from an arithmetic ball-quotient arrangement containing an abelian surface with infinite cyclic pi_1-image; hyperbolic path-graph readings verify infinite order and non-Stein cover.

title: Zariski cancellation and affine fibrations over the complex numbers
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∃ integral complex affine fourfold X = Spec A, A = ℂ[p,s,u,F,J]/(H) explicit: A[w] ≅ ℂ^[5] ∧ A ≇ ℂ^[4]
backbone: Exhibit explicit algebra A; an exponentiated locally nilpotent derivation makes A[w] polynomial; a valuation degeneration and rigidity obstruction on derivations show A is not.

title: A characteristic-zero counterexample to Lipman–Zariski
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∃ finitely generated normal integral ℂ-algebra A of Krull dimension 2 and maximal ideal m: Der_ℂ(A) ≅ A^{⊕2} ∧ A_m not regular
backbone: Build a genus-21 curve with prescribed residue data, glue vector-field jets into an analytic contraction with free derivations, then algebraize by finite determinacy.

title: A stable-coordinate counterexample in four variables
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∃ explicit degree-5 f ∈ ℂ[x_1,…,x_4]: f is a coordinate of ℂ[x_1,…,x_4,w] but not of ℂ[x_1,…,x_4]
backbone: Exhibit an explicit degree-five polynomial via a hypersurface presentation that makes one-variable stabilization explicit; a graded/line-bundle obstruction shows a coordinate would force a derivation excluded by a rigidity argument.

title: A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∃ explicit rank-2 algebraic bundle G on P^1×P^1: ∀ m ≥ 1, E_m = f_m^*G ⊗ O(1,1) is ample, and ∃ m_0 ∀ m ≥ m_0, E_m has no smooth strictly Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric
backbone: Explicitly build a rank-two bundle G glued along three graphs; quotient sequences prove ampleness, while a Griffiths-positive metric would yield a quadratic limit and incompatible invariant measures.

title: Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ compact connected Kähler manifold X of positive dimension: (every holomorphic map ℂ → X is constant) → K_X ample
backbone: Extremal holomorphic discs and Hessian estimates give bounded canonical potentials, so K_X is nef; Aubin-Yau metrics with uniform volume give positive top self-intersection, so K_X is big, hence ample.

title: Tangent splittings and product decompositions
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ compact connected Kähler X of dim ≥ 2, ∀ splitting T_X = E_1 ⊕ E_2 into integrable holomorphic subbundles of positive rank: ∃ simply connected Y_1, Y_2 and biholomorphism Φ: X̃ → Y_1×Y_2 with dΦ(π^*E_i) = pr_i^*T_{Y_i}
backbone: Build holomorphic boxes tangent to E1,E2 by Hartogs-type and mixed-boundary extension, transport them along path rectangles, and assemble the product biholomorphism of the universal cover.

title: A counterexample to Pixton completeness in Chow
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∃ (g,n) = (10^60, 3·C(10^60,3)) and explicit Y ∈ S_{g,n}: q_{g,n}(Y) = 0 in CH^*(M̄_{g,n};ℚ) ∧ Y ∉ Pspan_{g,n}
backbone: Define an explicit alternating product of corrected small diagonals; a formal detector functional kills Pixton's span but not the class, while Quot-scheme virtual localization proves the class vanishes in Chow.

title: Irrational cubic fourfolds with Hodge-theoretic and categorical K3 associations
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀^∞ admissible d, ∀ᵍ cubic fourfold X ∈ C_d: X irrational ∧ ∃ K3 surface S with Ku(X) ≃ D^b(S)
backbone: Assume a very general cubic of large discriminant rational; a divisorial birational cocycle with integral lattice cancellation forces a K3 from a bounded test collection, impossible for large d.

title: Gepner symmetry and large-volume stability on threefolds
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ smooth complex quintic threefold X: ∃ numerical Bridgeland stability condition σ = (Z,P) with support property, Z(ΦE) = e^{2πi/5}Z(E), Φ(P(φ)) = P(φ+2/5), Z(O_x) = −1
backbone: Compute the unique Gepner eigencharge, build a two-parameter family of double-tilt aisles with uniform inclusion under the autoequivalence (using Xu's BG-type inequality), and refine to a slicing with support property.

title: Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ normal globally Weil ℚ-factorial compact Kähler fourfold X_0, ∀ rational boundary B_0, ∀ fixed analytically nef rational b-divisor M with (X_0,B_0+M) generalized lc, ∀ sequence of projective small generalized lc flips: the sequence is finite
backbone: Stabilize low-discrepancy places, extract terminal junctions, and show a nonnegative Shokurov-type difficulty (counted places plus cycle ranks) drops at surface flips while surface-class rank descends otherwise.

title: Fundamental groups of special complex varieties and root orbifolds
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ connected smooth compact Kähler manifold X: X special → π_1(X) has an abelian subgroup of finite index
backbone: On a maximal-Betti cover the Albanese fibre group N is FAb; if N were infinite, a minimal base and L2-Dolbeault/Hilbert-tensor arguments give a Bogomolov sheaf, contradicting specialness.

title: Semialgebraic universal covers and bounded domains
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ connected normal projective complex variety X: (X̃ biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety) ⇔ (∃ m, bounded symmetric D, simply connected normal projective F: X̃ ≅ D × ℂ^m × F)
backbone: Rescaling a semialgebraic cover with recenterings and successive faces builds an intrinsic quotient; its deck action is discrete with symmetric base; fibres and affine factor assemble the product.

title: Counterexamples to Zariski’s multiplicity conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∃ N (8 | N) ∃ reduced weighted-homogeneous f_1, f_2 ∈ ℝ[z_1,…,z_N] with isolated critical points, ord_0 f_1 = 2, ord_0 f_2 = 3, and (ℂ^N,V(f_1),0) ≅ (ℂ^N,V(f_2),0) ambiently homeomorphic
backbone: Chain-type weighted-homogeneous seeds of orders 2 and 3 with matching spectra; local-global arithmetic gives an integral Seifert isometry; open-book classification yields the ambient homeomorphism.

title: The Global Spherical Shell conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ connected minimal compact complex surface X of class VII with b_2(X) > 0: ∃ global spherical shell Σ ⊂ X (biholomorphic image of a neighbourhood of S^3 ⊂ ℂ^2∖{0} with X∖Σ connected)
backbone: Weighted Dolbeault index theory on the cyclic cover gives sections whose divisors have only compact components (cylinder estimates); counting b2 rational curves yields a global spherical shell.

title: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ closed connected positive quaternionic-Kähler manifold (M^{4m},g), m ≥ 2: (M,g) is homothetic to a Wolf space (via: ∀ contact Fano X of dim ≥ 3 ∃ simple 𝔤 with (X,F) ≅ adjoint variety Y_𝔤)
backbone: Smooth two contact lines into very free conics, extend moving-pair tensors over stable-map compactification to get a global section, deduce contact transitivity, identify with adjoint variety, then twistor correspondence.

title: The generalized Mukai conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
claim: ∀ smooth connected complex Fano manifold X of dimension n > 0, Picard number ρ, pseudoindex ι: ρ(ι−1) ≤ n, and equality ⇔ X ≅ (P^{ι−1})^ρ
backbone: Point-descendant lower bounds force algebraically independent eigenvalues of quantum divisor matrices, giving rho independent chained curve degrees; the ordered-chain method gives the bound, minimal families equality.

subject: Probability and statistical mechanics

title: The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation law
subject: Probability and statistical mechanics
claim: ∀ β>1: Var F_n(β) ~ c_β n^{1/3} with c_β > 0, and (F_n − E F_n)/sd(F_n) ⇒ ν_β (a unique nondegenerate law), for zero-field Gaussian SK

title: Conformal universality for weakly interacting and random-bond Ising models
subject: Probability and statistical mechanics

title: GOE bulk universality for regular graphs with weak Anderson disorder
subject: Probability and statistical mechanics
claim: ∀ d≥3, ∀ E ∈ (−2√(d−1), 2√(d−1)), ∀ f∈C_c^+: |E exp(−∫f dΞ_{n,d,E}) − E exp(−∫f dΞ_n^GOE)| → 0 as n→∞ (uniform random d-regular graph G_{n,d})

subject: Probability and statistical mechanics

subject: Probability and statistical mechanics
